namespace Probe1968

#check @paperBadBasePlace
#check @paperQVZeroLocusGlobal
#check @PaperFmod
#check @paperGlobalRealifiedFrobenioid
#check @IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg
#check @IUTIVArithmeticDivisor.deg_single

#check @S1487Cand.order_pos

-- 1. defeq of the bad place type
example (D : S1895PaperInput) :
    (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces = Bad (S1280Selection D.l) := rfl

-- 2. initial is definitionally the S1527 source data
example (D : S1895PaperInput) :
    (paperInput D).initial =
      S1527SourceData D.l D.R D.redCompat D.hredCompat D.torCompat D.htorCompat
        D.orbCompat D.horbCompat D.secCompat D.hsecCompat D.cusCompat D.hcusCompat := rfl

-- 3. units of the concrete value monoid are trivial
example : Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^) := by
  constructor
  intro a b
  have key : forall u : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^,
      (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) = 1 := by
    intro u
    have hmul : (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) *
        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) = 1 :=
      Units.mul_inv u
    have hta : Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) +
        Multiplicative.toAdd
          ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg Multiplicative.toAdd hmul
      simpa [Multiplicative.toAdd_mul, Multiplicative.toAdd_one] using h
    have hx : (Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) : Real) <= 0 :=
      (Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).property
    have hy : (Multiplicative.toAdd
        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) : Real) <= 0 :=
      (Multiplicative.toAdd
        ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)).property
    have hsum : (Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) : Real) +
        (Multiplicative.toAdd
          ((u⁻¹ : (SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^) : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) : Real) = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun z : sourceHaarActualNonpositiveAddSubmonoid => (z : Real)) hta
      simpa using h
    have hzero : (Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) : Real) = 0 := by
      linarith
    have h0 : Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid) = 0 := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hzero
    calc (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)
        = Multiplicative.ofAdd (Multiplicative.toAdd (u : SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)) := rfl
      _ = Multiplicative.ofAdd 0 := by rw [h0]
      _ = 1 := rfl
  exact (key a).trans (key b).symm

-- 4. times-mu fiber of the anchor is trivial
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) :
    Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)^ := by
  change Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^)
  infer_instance

example (D : S1895PaperInput) (v : PaperV) :
    Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v) := by
  change Subsingleton (TimesMuQuotient ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)^)
  constructor
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective x
  obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective y
  haveI : Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)^ := by
    change Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^)
    infer_instance
  rw [Subsingleton.elim u w]

-- 5. R6 forces the paper strip's times-mu fibers to be subsingletons
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (P : SourceFTimesMuPrimeStrip PaperV)
    (h : Nonempty (QPilotAnchorIdentification D P)) (v : PaperV) :
    Subsingleton (P.timesMu v) := by
  obtain ⟨phi⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨psi, hpsi⟩ := SourceFTimesMuPrimeStripFullPolyIsomorphism.representative_exists phi
  haveI : Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotTimesMu D).timesMu v) := by
    change Subsingleton (TimesMuQuotient ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)^)
    constructor
    intro x y
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective x
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := TimesMuQuotient.quotientMap_surjective y
    haveI : Subsingleton ((reducedQPilotAnchor D).Mon v)^ := by
      change Subsingleton ((SourceHaarActualValueMonoid)^)
      infer_instance
    rw [Subsingleton.elim u w]
  constructor
  intro x y
  obtain ⟨x', rfl⟩ := (psi.isoTimesMu v).surjective x
  obtain ⟨y', rfl⟩ := (psi.isoTimesMu v).surjective y
  rw [Subsingleton.elim x' y']

-- 6. weight of the bad base place is log 5
example (D : S1895PaperInput) (b : (paperInput D).initial.badPlaces) :
    IUTIVPlace.weight (PaperFmod D) (IUTIVPlace.finite (paperBadBasePlace D b)) = Real.log 5 := by
  have hplace : b.1 = concreteGaussianFivePlace := by
    have hb := S1527_bad_val_eq D.l b
    rw [show S1280Place D.l = concreteGaussianFivePlace from rfl] at hb
    exact hb
  show Real.log (Ideal.absNorm (paperBadBasePlace D b).asIdeal : Real) = Real.log 5
  have hbase : paperBadBasePlace D b = concreteGaussianFivePlace.maximalIdeal := by
    unfold paperBadBasePlace
    rw [hplace]
  rw [hbase]
  have habs : Ideal.absNorm (concreteGaussianFivePlace.maximalIdeal.asIdeal) = 5 := by
    rw [Ideal.absNorm_apply, Submodule.cardQuot_apply]
    simpa [NumberFieldFinitePlace.ResidueField, NumberFieldFinitePlace.underlyingPrime]
      using concreteGaussianFivePlaceResidueField_card
  rw [habs]
  norm_num

end Probe1968
